guard_semantics: For a non-meta table, isTableDisabled reads the table state through getTableState/MetaTableAccessor; if it is DISABLED, relocateRegion throws TableNotEnabledException.
injection: IOException at the exact named RegionServer ClientService.Get request handled before the selected client guard; the pilot shows response/retry and reaches the same client call without selected exception.
pilot_conclusion: No new bug from the pilot. A taken coverage branch is not evidence that the selected TableNotEnabledException was thrown.
